languages.description: Target languages to (re-)translate. A language already present on the recording is retranslated, not skipped — only list a language here if you want it (re-)run. Any BCP-47-style code with translation support is accepted except the literal `auto` placeholder. Do not pass the recording's source language: the request is rejected with `400`, and nothing is started for any of its languages.

ignoredLanguages.description: Subset of `languages` whose subtitles you provide yourself (upload them with `POST .../subtitles/upload` or `PUT .../subtitles` first): Studio does not translate them. They are tracked as provided, not pending or failed. A language that the recording does not have yet is charged like any new translation language.

tmsProjectTemplateUid.description: Phrase TMS project template uid. Get it from the Phrase TMS API (project templates); Studio has no endpoint that lists it.

subtitleProfiles.description: Subtitle profile id per language code. List available ids with GET /v1/subtitle-profiles.

styleGuides.description: Style guide ids by language code. Get them from the Style Guides API; Studio has no endpoint that lists them.

termBases.description: Phrase TMS term base uids by language code. Get them from the Phrase TMS API (term bases); Studio has no endpoint that lists them.
